mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP3A4 metabolism of erythromycin, reducing erythromycin concentrations and efficacy, while erythromycin may inhibit phenobarbital metabolism.
action: Monitor erythromycin efficacy closely; consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., azithromycin or non-macrolide) or increase erythromycin dose if interaction unavoidable; monitor phenobarbital levels.
